title: Roofr awarded 2026 Power Partners INC Award
summary: The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards recognizes Roofr as a company that provide essential services and expertise to help entrepreneurs and businesses grow.
body_markdown:
*The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards recognizes B2B companies that provide essential services and expertise to help entrepreneurs and businesses grow.*


SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 20, 2026 -- Roofr, an all-in-one CRM build for roofers by roofers, has been named a 2026[Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800999-1&h=2926764481&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inc.com%2Fpower-partner-awards&a=Inc.)[Power Partner Awards](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800999-1&h=662103080&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inc.com%2Fpower-partner-awards&a=Power+Partner+Awards) winner, recognizing the company among the leading B2B partners supporting entrepreneurs and businesses across the country.


The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards honor B2B companies that have demonstrated a track record of helping entrepreneurs and businesses navigate the challenges of building and growing a company. From hiring and compliance to technology, infrastructure, fundraising, marketing, and more, these partners provide expertise and services that enable businesses to operate, scale, and pursue their ambitions.


"Business owners have no shortage of tools at their disposal, and B2B companies need to make clear why their products and services are worth the investment," says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. "The companies on this year's Power Partners list have done just that. They don't just have customers – they have superfans and evangelists. Across industries like marketing, financial services, and technology, they've proved their dedication to helping fellow business owners grow and succeed."


"When we've gone up against other roofing CRMs and come out on top? It's a great feeling." says Richy Nelson, CEO. "It speaks to the team's dedication to building a great product that puts our customers first. We're honoured with this award, and we're excited to continue our great work into 2027."


Roofr was recognized for their deep commitment to their customers while creating a tool that is focused on solving challenges within roofing. Constant quality of life product updates, request tracking, and even an internal customer feedback forum helps to keep the Roofr team focused on what the real challenges are that their customers need solutions to.


With the[Roofr of the Month program](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800999-1&h=3020709734&u=https%3A%2F%2Froofr.com%2Frotm%3Futm_source%3Dcision%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3D10-20-INC-ROTM&a=Roofr+of+the+Month+program) , Roofr celebrates their customers, putting their stories in the spotlight with features and podcasts. The Roofr team is active in Facebook and community groups, and you'll often see their CEO, Richy Nelson, engaging with customers and answering questions.


Roofr is as invested in its customers' success as much as its own.


For more information on Inc.'s Power Partner Awards or to view the complete list of honorees, visit[https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800999-1&h=4277781447&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inc.com%2Fpower-partner-awards&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inc.com%2Fpower-partner-awards) .


###


**About Roofr**


[Roofr](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800999-1&h=780926685&u=https%3A%2F%2Froofr.com%2F%3Futm_source%3Dcision%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3D10-20-INC-roofr&a=Roofr) is an all-in-one roofing software platform built for contractors across North America. From instant estimates and aerial measurements to proposals, payments, and CRM, Roofr gives roofing businesses the tools to close more jobs, run more efficiently, and grow — without the complexity of stitching together multiple systems.
